messages:
jen: Morning — quick eng-releases async. Where are we on the release train for v2.3 today? Any pending cherry-picks or blockers we should surface before the 12:00 deploy window?

alex: Cherry-picked #4821 (fix: token accounting edgecase) into release/v2.3 — commit abc1234 -> def5678. CI passed on linux/arm and linux/x86. Needs QA signoff.

priya: QA ran basic smoke. Found failure in e2e: `tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py::test_prefix_kv` — flake but reproduced locally once. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345. Looks related to recent batching changes.

deploy-bot: Canary started for release/v2.3 on pool-prod-us-east-1. Canary id: canary-20240325-77. Logs: https://canary.redwood.internal/canary-77 :rocket:

marco: Heads up — attempted to cherry-pick #4798 (protobuf alignment) into release/v2.3 and hit a conflict in vendor/proto/shim.proto. Will need to resolve; ETA ~30–45m.

samir: Re: priya's kv_cache flake — I traced it to missing env var `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH` defaulting to false in docker image. Quick patch: set default to true in runtime bootstrap. I can push a hotfix branch `hotfix/kv-default` and cherry-pick. Should we pause canary?

alex: If samir's patch is small we should cherry-pick it before canary widens. I can drop the cherrypick PR once samir pushes. Locally tests pass with the env var set.

priya: +1 to pause widening until hotfix applied and we re-run the failing e2e suite (kv_cache one). I can re-run CI and smoke canary after. Prefer deploy window shift to 11:30 PST if needed.

jen: Holding canary widening for now — @samir please open the hotfix PR and tag @alex for the cherry-pick. @marco take the conflict on #4798 as highest priority. If canary still flaky after hotfix, we'll postpone today's release.

samir: Created PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4902 — branch hotfix/kv-default. Cherry-pick target release/v2.3: `git checkout release/v2.3 && git cherry-pick -x def890a`

alex: I pushed the cherry-pick branch `cherry/4821-4902` and opened PR #4905 against release/v2.3. Tests green in CI. Requesting @priya for smoke run and LGTM.

priya: Starting smoke run now. Will post results in ~12m.

deploy-bot: Canary canary-20240325-77 paused by request from jen. Reason: pending hotfix cherry-pick.

marco: Conflict resolved for #4798, updated branch `cherry/4798-resolved`. PTAL @alex @jen. Took ~20m due to proto shim reorder.

priya: Smoke run done — kv_cache test passed 3/3 on CI after hotfix applied. Manually verified through canary node: sample requests look good. Moving to canary widen when you give the go.

jen: Thanks everyone. Resume canary widen at lunchtime (11:30 PST). If anything else pops up, drop notes here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary widen scheduled: canary-20240325-77 -> widen to 10% at 11:30 PST. Will post status updates.
